name: Yogi Infra Projects Limited
about: Yogi Infra Projects Limited engages in the construction and infrastructure projects in India. The company develops, leases, sells, mortgages, hypothecates, and disposes apartments, commercial and factory buildings, hotels, malls, office buildings, residential flats, factory sheds, cinema theatres, shopping complexes, commercial premises, industrial sites and sheds, guest and lodging houses, cottages, tourist bungalows, shops, godowns, restaurants, touring talkies, and other civil structures, as well as places of entertainment, recreation, pleasure, and other immovable properties. It also acts as a real estate advisers/consultants/brokers, and real estate agent builders promoters. The company was formerly known as Yogi Sung-Won (India) Limited and changed its name to Yogi Infra Projects Limited in January 2009. Yogi Infra Projects Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
